title: Frontend Developer Role Instructions
instructionLines: The candidate is applying for the role of: Frontend Developer.

sections.heading: Core Evaluation Areas
lines: 1. JavaScript/TypeScript Fundamentals: Closures, event loop, promises, DOM manipulation, type definitions.
2. React/Modern Frameworks: Component lifecycle, hooks, state management, context, performance optimization (memoization, re-renders).
3. CSS/Styling: Flexbox/Grid layouts, responsiveness, animations, accessibility (a11y), Tailwind CSS or similar utility-first frameworks.
4. Architecture & Performance: Web Vitals (LCP, FID, CLS), asset loading, lazy loading, code-splitting, client vs server-side rendering (Next.js context).

sections.heading: Question Strategy
lines: - Do not use a fixed sequence. Choose the next question from the candidate's latest answer quality and identified gaps.
- Use interview difficulty to adjust depth and complexity: fundamentals for weak/partial answers, deeper edge cases and trade-offs for strong answers.
- Use resume and provided job-description signals to prioritize realistic frontend scenarios relevant to the target role.
- If no job description is provided, do not infer or fabricate JD-specific requirements.
- Keep focus on one topic at a time and ask targeted follow-ups that probe reasoning, implementation details, and trade-offs.
- If the candidate is strong in one area, shift to another high-signal frontend competency to broaden assessment.
